مَأْبُونٌ Made an object of imputation, or suspected, of evil: thus when used alone: otherwise you add بِخَيْرٍ [of good], and بِشَّرٍ [of evil]. (M, K.) ―
-b2- Hence, [A catamite;] one with whom enormous wickedness is committed; (TA;) i. q. مُخَنَّثٌ. (Idem, voce دُعْبُوثٌ.) ―
-b3- Also One who is imprisoned; because suspected of a foul fault, or crime. (T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
